# Templates

This folder contains starter templates you can use to begin new worlds quickly.

## How templates work

Each template contains a set of configuration files and a preview image. When you launch a template from the app, TerraNova uses this folder to populate the new world.

### Example templates
- **Starter Island**: Basic terrain, a single biome, and minimal nodes.
- **Mountain Range**: Multi-biome terrain with height-based transitions.

> Note: In v1 this is a documentation placeholder; later versions will include a template picker UI that reads from this folder.
